name: Mary Smith

relationships.evidence: Pelletreau: children of Daniel Smith 2d and Hannah Brewster include 'Mary, born May 25, 1735, married Judge Wm. Smith, of "Tangiers" family'

bioAdditions: Bull Smith -> Daniel -> Daniel 2d -> Mary: 2nd cousin 9 times removed. Mother of Senator John Smith (born 1752, when she was about 16).

sources.citation: W. S. Pelletreau (ed.), Records of the Town of Smithtown (1898), Appendix (archive.org full text, scans recordsoftownofs00smitrich and recordstownsmit00pellgoog), App. pp. 476, 491
sources.supports: Mary b. 25 May 1735 dau. of Daniel 2d; m. Judge William Smith; mother of Gen. John Smith
